display_long_description:
THE CROWD SAID is a live VR game show where your friends are the contestants, the host, and the audience.

Two teams face off to guess the crowd's most popular answers. Buzz in first, choose PLAY or PASS, chain correct answers as a team, and steal the round when the other side strikes out. The pot doubles in the final round — winners take the glory and the leaderboard spot.

BE THE HOST — Grab the host card and the show is yours: reveal answers, hand out strikes, run the timer, and command the stage with an extended host voice.

BE THE SHOW — Real Meta Avatars with walking legs, hand tracking, claps and gesture emotes. Light shows react to the game, confetti flies, and the applause meter feeds on the crowd's energy.

BUILT FOR PARTIES — Drop-in multiplayer voice with whisper zones, a meme soundboard booth, video screens, sit spots, and a backstage area for the show's staff. Lifetime stats follow your Meta account: visits, playtime, wins, monthly champions, and the Hall of Fame.

EARLY ACCESS — The show grows every week: new rounds, bigger question banks, and fresh features are on the way. Step up to the podium!
